remarks: Perched atop one of the highest ridgelines in its Hollywood Hills setting, this distinctive Spanish-inspired residence commands breathtaking, unobstructed jetliner views of the surrounding mountains, valley, and cityscape. With no homes directly across the street, the property enjoys an exceptional sense of privacy and openness rarely found in hillside living. Dramatic 25 foot floor-to-ceiling windows bring the spectacular scenery indoors, while multiple expansive decks create seamless opportunities for outdoor entertaining, relaxation, and enjoying the ever-changing landscape.
